name: rescuemesh
description: RescueMesh — Intelligent Disaster Emergency Communication Network (backend, dashboard, mobile)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix dashboard install && npm --prefix mobile install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm --prefix backend run setup
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,dashboard -c red,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix dashboard run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix dashboard run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix mobile test
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix dashboard run build
